design_intent: quiet approachable service equipment with an original appearance and cost-controlled replaceable covers

form_language.base_plan: rounded rectangle with a dark lower impact band and visually recessed wheels
form_language.tower: slender symmetric lift shroud with a removable rear service spine
form_language.shoulder: compact horizontal bridge that keeps both arm roots visually and mechanically separate
form_language.display: slightly downward-facing service display with flush camera brow
form_language.decorative_elements: none beyond one functional status light

exterior_parts.name: display and sensor brow
exterior_parts.process_production: injection moulded polymer only after DFM

human_interfaces.service_disconnect_location: rear base behind labelled access door

sensor_integration.lidar_location: front base center above impact band
sensor_integration.sensor_windows: individually replaceable optically suitable windows; no common dark cosmetic visor
sensor_integration.ultrasonic_locations: perimeter base at front corners sides and rear corners

thermal_and_environment.airflow: filtered low rear intake to high rear exhaust without crossing battery vent path
thermal_and_environment.liquid_shedding: top surfaces slope away from display sensor windows and service seams
thermal_and_environment.target_ingress_rating: IPX2 concept target; supplier sealing design and test required

serviceability.battery_removal_direction: rear horizontal on isolated slide tray

release_blockers: supplier Class-A surface CAD draft radii splits and tolerances are not complete
selected arm and sensor supplier geometry has not been integrated
full lift and fourteen-joint cable sweeps have not been physically executed
human reach visibility glare acoustic thermal ingress and cleaning trials are not executed
color material finish samples and cosmetic defect limits are not approved
